description: This Java interface defines configuration settings for health checks within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods to determine if health checking is enabled and to specify the interval for health checks, along with an enumeration of known configuration values.

classes.name: BasicHealthCheckConfig
classes.description: An interface that provides configuration settings for Ditto's runtime health checking behavior. It includes methods to check if health checking is enabled and to retrieve the health check interval. It also contains an enum listing known configuration path expressions and default values.

classes.name: HealthCheckConfigValue
classes.description: An enum implementing KnownConfigValue that defines known configuration keys and their default values for health checking, including 'ENABLED' and 'INTERVAL'.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns true if global health checking is enabled, false otherwise.

methods.name: getInterval
methods.description: Returns the interval duration between health checks.
